Select all IC50 activity rows for human Pim-1 kinase. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, assays, and target_dictionary. Join compound_structures to retrieve canonical_smiles. Join docs to retrieve pubmed_id or doi. Join compound_records to retrieve compound_key. Return columns: compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism. Filter by target name 'Pim-1 kinase' and organism 'Homo sapiens' and standard_type 'IC50'. Do not deduplicate. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
